text_block_list.text:
One day, I happened upon Ines Fujin
chatting and laughing with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if it's your first time, I definitely recommend retail or food service!
This magazine is packed full of job listings~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many...!
Is there anything catching your eye, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, they all look appealing,
but it is a bit difficult to imagine what the actual contents entail...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Yahoo-yahoo!
These two were just asking me
for advice about part-time jobs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be great real-world experience!
So I was asking all about what kind of jobs are out there.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So getting back to what I was saying,
convenience stores and food delivery often
welcome Umamusume, so I totally recommend them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see! Carrying heavy loads while doing lots of running
seems like great strength training too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... Um, so what exactly
would this part-time job entail?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You mean wearing a mascot costume? It was super fun playing with the little kids!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of fun things,
assisting in the magic show and reading picture books aloud were really memorable, too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And then... ah, excavating ruins, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ruins?! You've done that kind of thing before?!
Wait, they actually have part-time jobs like that?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You won't often find me in magazines like this, though!
I also sell bento boxes at baseball stadiums, and—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "A-At a baseball stadium!? I can work at a baseball stadium!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Wow, this is amazing...
I was already surprised by how many types of part-time jobs
there are in just one magazine, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To think that Ines-san has experienced almost all of that...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, leave the part-time work to me~!
Wait... huh?
Following Ines Fuujin's gaze, I saw an Umamusume carrying a tray loaded with desserts, walking while looking away.

Just as I think to myself how dangerous it looks,
the Umamusume's foot slips—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Look out!

"...Everyone braced for the tragic sight
of the dessert crashing onto the floor.
However."
(*fwhwip-fwhwip*!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Thank goodness, that was a nice catch!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When you carry a tray, you support it with your fingers,
not your palm, to keep it steady! And of course,
make sure not to look away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...
I'm so sorr~y...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
J-Just now... in midair, like *whoosh-whoosh-whoosh*!
You caught all the dessert that was about to spill, didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I've done it before at a part-time job!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What on earth is the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's not like I took some ninja-themed part-time job,
I just picked it up from working at a family restaurant.
Ines Fujin laughed carefree, but it seemed her part-time job experience came in handy in all sorts of situations.
choice_data_list: Feels like you could do anything.
Feels like you could do anything.

text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin laughed carefree, but it seemed her part-time job experience came in handy in all sorts of situations.
choice_data_list: Feels like you could do anything.
Feels like you could do anything.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah♪ But I'm not done yet.
There are sooo many more professional jobs out there in the world!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
People who know schools of tuna inside out,
people who study soil from scratch to grow delicious rice,
people who draw deeply moving paintings with just a few colored pencils...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Having seen true professionals, I can't just go around
saying I can do anything! The world is far too vast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Is Ines aiming too high,
or am I just lacking real-world experience...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like we're no longer talking about a part-time job,
but about master craftsmanship..."
While what Ines Fuujin was talking about felt a bit too grand in scale—it was an incident that made me truly appreciate how incredible she is all over again.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks for the compliment!
It's something I do just because I love it,
so hearing that feels a bit surreal.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that makes me want to balance it
with my training even more from now on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Could the secret to Ines's strength...
actually be her part-time jobs?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Part-time work truly is
such a valuable learning experience...!

I feel like those two might have slightly the wrong
idea, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer!
Keep on supporting me, okay?♪
Believe it or not, I really do rely on you.

—It was a moment that truly reaffirmed
the bond I shared with her.
